design_info.name: popcount
design_info.summary: Population count of a 256-bit word, 9-bit result, registered.

reasons: correct; 70.0 MHz is below target 105: shorten the slowest path
the 256-input adder chain din_r->count_r is the whole critical path: split it into registered partial sums
checks.critical_path: din_r->count_r 14.28ns (21 logic hops, logic 4.85 route 8.90) carryx21 @L10

reasons: slowest path is the 16-way sum g_r->count_r: add another tree level, latency budget 6 allows 3 more stages
checks.critical_path: g_r->count_r 8.43ns (14 logic hops, logic 3.02 route 5.12) carryx14 @L12,L22

reasons: final 4-way add s2_r->count_r is now the slowest path: split it into two registered 2-way adds
checks.critical_path: s2_r->count_r 6.49ns (10 logic hops, logic 2.16 route 3.80) carryx10 @L13,L29

reasons: route delay now dominates (2.61 of 4.38 ns): further gains need placement, not logic depth
checks.critical_path: s3_r->count_r 4.38ns (6 logic hops, logic 1.41 route 2.61) carryx6 @L14,L30
